data.title: As Part of Its Social Responsibility Initiatives, Riyadh Season Hosts Zahra Walk 2026 at Boulevard City
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Boulevard City hosted Zahra Walk 2026 on Saturday, organized by the Zahra Breast Cancer Association under the patronage of Riyadh Season as part of its social responsibility initiatives. The event was attended by Chairwoman of the Association’s Board of Directors Princess Haifa bint Faisal, and witnessed strong community engagement, with registration reaching its full capacity of 3,500 participants ahead of the event.
    Hosting the walk reflects Riyadh Season’s commitment to supporting community and awareness initiatives and promoting a culture of breast cancer prevention and early detection. The event brought together people of different ages to participate in an activity carrying an important humanitarian and health message under the slogan “Your Path Is Pink,” in support of breast cancer patients and survivors.
    The walk began at 4:00 p.m., featuring two routes of 1 km and 3 km. The event also included several dedicated activity zones, featuring an awareness exhibition, a stage for interactive performances, a children’s area, and designated spaces for medal presentations and participant kit distribution, alongside food and hospitality areas.
    The initiative attracted significant interest, with the Zahra Breast Cancer Association announcing that registration had reached full capacity and closed before the event began. Proceeds from ticket sales will contribute to sponsoring breast cancer patients and supporting their treatment journeys, giving participation a humanitarian dimension that extends beyond the sporting and awareness activities.
    The walk was held in strategic partnership with Riyadh Season and the Saudi Sports for All Federation, with support from ROSHN Group as the main partner, alongside several supporting organizations and sponsors. The collaboration reflects a model of cooperation across different sectors to advance health and community initiatives.
    Hosting Zahra Walk 2026 at Boulevard City builds on Riyadh Season’s ongoing efforts to support initiatives with a positive community impact and utilize its entertainment destinations to accommodate health and humanitarian activities. These efforts reinforce its role in social responsibility while contributing to greater health awareness and improved quality of life.
    -- SPA
